info.text:
Home electricity prices are up about 32% since 2020 (not adjusted for inflation; overall prices rose about 24%).
Average US home price: 13.15 cents per kWh in 2020, 17.3 cents in 2025 (EIA).
Example: 1,000 kWh a month went from about $132 to $173.
EIA's Sept 2026 forecast: 18.2 cents in 2026, with record power use driven by data centers and factories.
EIA's October outlook and Winter Fuels Outlook come out Oct 6, 2026.
Sources: EIA Electric Power Annual Table 2.4; EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook, Sept 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
